    AccountTokenRepository.consume(String hashedToken, String purpose, Instant now)

    AccountTokenRepository.findUsable(String hashedToken, String purpose, Instant now)
    Finds an unused, unexpired token with the given hash and purpose, without consuming it, so that a caller can run every check before spending the token.
